 154:     """
 155:     Differential Flatness FOC Controller for NANOTEC DB42S02.
 156: 
 157:     Architecture
 158:     ------------
 159:     SpeedFusion : complementary filter blending encoder IIR and SMO estimates.
 160:     SMO         : Sliding Mode Observer for back-EMF / electrical speed.
 161:     EKF         : Extended Kalman Filter (optional, 3-state: id, iq, omega_m)
 162:     Voltage law : flatness feedforward with id/iq proportional correction terms.
 163: 
 164:     Observer Modes
 165:     --------------
 166:     - SMO (0)   : Sliding Mode Observer only (default, matches original production)
 167:     - EKF (1)   : Extended Kalman Filter only (smoother estimate, higher CPU cost)
 168:     - BLEND (2) : Convex blend: omega = (1-w)*SMO + w*EKF
 169: 
 170:     Parameters
 171:     ----------
 172:     v_dc : float
 173:         DC bus voltage [V].  Default 17.0.
 174:     p_poles : int
 175:         Pole pairs.  Default 4.
 176:     R_s : float
 177:         Stator resistance [Ohm].  Default 0.285.
 178:     L_d : float
 179:         d-axis inductance [H].  Default 3.675e-4.
 180:     L_q : float
 181:         q-axis inductance [H].  Default 3.675e-4.
 182:     lambda_pm : float
 183:         Permanent magnet flux linkage [Wb].  Default 0.0014.
 184:     i_max : float
 185:         Maximum phase current [A].  Default 3.57.
 186:     dt_s : float
 187:         Nominal sampling time [s].  Default 50e-6 (20 kHz).
 188:     kp_speed : float
 189:         Speed P-gain [A/(rad/s)].  Default 0.4.
 190:     kp_id : float
 191:         D-axis current P-gain [V/A].  Default 0.4.
 192:     kp_iq : float
 193:         Q-axis current P-gain [V/A].  Default 8.0.
 194: 
 195:     Notes
 196:     -----
 197:     Motor parameters and gains are compile-time constants in the C headers.
 198:     Constructor arguments are for API documentation; edit the #defines and
 199:     recompile to change them.
 200: 
 201:     EKF is 3-state (id, iq, omega_m). theta_e is integrated internally from
 202:     omega_m. q_theta and p0_theta parameters are ignored (kept for API compatibility).
 203: 
 204:     Attributes (readonly)
 205:     ---------------------
 206:     v_alpha : float          Alpha-axis voltage reference [V].
 207:     v_beta : float           Beta-axis voltage reference [V].
 208:     speed_est : float        Speed estimate [rad/s] (depends on observer mode).
 209:     iq_ref : float           q-axis current reference [A].
 210:     fusion_alpha : float     SpeedFusion weight (0 = encoder, 1 = SMO).
 211:     omega_e : float          Fused electrical speed [rad/s].
 212:     omega_smo : float        SMO mechanical speed estimate [rad/s].
 213:     omega_ekf : float        EKF mechanical speed estimate [rad/s].
 214:     status : int             0 = success.
 215: 
 216:     Examples
 217:     --------
 218:     >>> ctrl = DFCControllerWrapper()
 219:     >>> ctrl.set_inputs_individual(209.4, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
 220:     >>> ctrl.compute(50e-6)
 221:     >>> v_alpha, v_beta = ctrl.get_outputs()
 222:     """
